## CORE RULE 1. Avoid being a negative influence on others experience.
Never do anything for the purpose of harming someone else’s experience.
- [color=indianred]Don’t be overly negative or hostile.[/color] Accept that losing is part of the game, and keep a positive attitude. We don’t allow insulting behavior or needless arguing with others. If someone asks you to stop or gets offended, avoid continuing or else admins would consider it a more serious matter. - [color=indianred]Don’t use OOC to complain about other players.[/color] You should be speaking to admins if you need to make complaints. Don’t threaten to ahelp others, argue about rules, and never use in-character actions as punishment instead of ahelping. - Avoid being unfair to others and don’t interact negatively with SSD/AFK players, except when necessary in order to perform job duties or complete objectives.
